Economists have long observed that reductions in export tariffs tend to increase the volume of goods a country ships abroad. To better understand this relationship, a team led by Oluwaseyi Moejoh and Adjoa Dlamini examined trade data from three nations that lowered tariffs between 2015 and 2020. Their analysis suggested that a post-reduction increase in export volume above 15% typically indicates a meaningful market response, so they concluded that both Kenya and Vietnam demonstrated meaningful responses to their tariff reductions.
prompt: Which choice best describes data from the graph that support the team's conclusion?

choices.A: Both Kenya and Vietnam were found to have export volume increases greater than 15%.
choices.B: Kenya was found to have an export volume increase many times greater than that found for Peru.
choices.C: Vietnam was found to have a greater export volume increase than Kenya and Peru were found to have.
choices.D: Peru was found to have an export volume increase below 15%.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer. The researchers concluded that both Kenya and Vietnam demonstrated meaningful responses to their tariff reductions because post-reduction increases in export volume above 15% typically indicate such responses. This choice accurately describes data from the graph that support that conclusion: Kenya had an export volume increase of approximately 42%, and Vietnam had an increase of approximately 28%. Since both values exceed the 15% threshold, this data supports the conclusion that both countries demonstrated meaningful market responses.
